articleTitle: Grape Leaf Disease Detection And Classification Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Plant diseases present a major threat to global food security, affecting agricultural productivity and livelihoods across the globe. We implemented two different model architectures for comparison: a custom CNN model designed specifically for plant disease detection and the VGG16 pretrained model,. To optimize the performance of these models, we tested three popular optimization techniques: RMSprop, Adam, and Nadam, SGD. The performance of the custom CNN model and the VGG16 model when trained with different optimization algorithms. Across all experiments, the Adam optimizer consistently achieved the highest accuracy, with an average accuracy of 96%. The Nadam optimizer, while also exhibiting strong performance, yielded slightly lower accuracy, averaging $\mathbf{9 1 \%}$. In contrast, the SGD optimizer lagged behind significantly, achieving an average accuracy of only 55%. These results suggest that the choice of optimization algorithm has a significant impact on the convergence speed and final accuracy of machine learning models for plant leaf disease detection.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Rabbit Algorithm with Gaussian Process Classifier for Detection of Adenocarcinoma from Lung Cancer Histopathological Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Lung and colon cancers are among the most common and fatal tumors. In 2022, 4.27 million people were diagnosed with lung and colon cancer, and more than 2.74 million died worldwide. Parts of the lungs affected by cancer are located utilizing image processing techniques such as noise reduction, feature extraction, damaged region identification, and possibly a comparison to a medical history of lung cancer. The primary goal of this study is to employ Rabbit Algorithm with Gaussian process classifier to detect and classify cancer using histopathology images of lung. The LC25000 collection contains $\mathbf{2 5, 0 0 0}$ histopathological images from the human lung and colon, including both malignant and normal scans. Classifier performance parameters like Accuracy, Error rates, F1 score, Sensitivity, Specificity, Critical Success Index (CSI) and Youden’s Index (YI) are used to assess how well a classifier can distinguish between classes. Results indicate that an accuracy rate of $\mathbf{9 1. 6 7 \%}$ in detecting Adenocarcinoma can be achieved using the Rabbit Algorithm which is also characterized by the Gaussian Process Classifier.

articleTitle: Optimized Phishing Detection through URL Analysis By a Gradient Boosting-RNN Ensemble
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Phishing detection is the process of identifying and preventing illegal attempts to get private data, including passwords or bank account information, by acting to be legitimate organizations via fake websites. A Phishing detection System, is a combination machine learning approach that combines the XGBoost, CatBoost, and Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM) algorithms is proposed it is possible to identify phishing URLs from fraudulent ones, feature extraction leverages components such as URL structure duration, and domain-specific indicators. In order of precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy measurements the combined model’s weighted stacking ensemble method performs better than traditional methods. These performance metrics, which are calculated using a dataset comprising hundreds of URLs, demonstrate the enhanced classification accuracy of the proposed model. The system’s processing efficiency and scalability enable real-time detection, accurately determining whether a URL is phishing or legitimate.

articleTitle: A smart automated attendance monitoring system using deep learning model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Managing student attendance by hand or through ERP can be a big task for teachers and faculty members. The smart and automatic attendance system is easier to make the process in an efficient manner. During the analysis process, feedback from the user is done. The proposed system helps to stop issues like student marking attendance for friends(proxies) who aren’t actually in the class. It’s always live through video feed and can be used for attendance. OpenCV captures the video frames, and the system also uses dlib to detect and recognize faces. It recognizes faces that are matched with a database of student photos to mark attendance. The proposed model gives an effective Automated tool that tracks the student time presence.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Local Binary Pattern Features with Eagle Optimization Algorithm based CNN Classifier for Breast Cancer Detection from Ultrasound Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Breast cancer detection at early stages is very much needed as it is one of the most prevalent cancer related death causing cancers among females. This paper poses an automated breast cancer detection based on analyzing ultrasound images using modern deep learning and optimization algorithms. We implement Local Binary Pattern feature extraction in addition to the Cuckoo Search Algorithm and Eagle Optimization Algorithm based CNN to improve the accuracy of the classification. The Eagle Optimization Algorithm on CNN classifier $\mathbf{97.89\%}$ results higher than the Cuckoo Search Algorithm on CNN classifier 95.46%. These results highlight the importance of good feature extraction and selection in enhancing the diagnosis.

articleTitle: Facial Emotion-Based Music Recommendation System with Social Media Sentiment Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel music recommendation system that leverages facial emotion recognition and social media sentiment analysis to personalize music suggestions for users. The proposed system utilizes facial emotion detection to interpret the user’s current mood and analyzes the sentiment of the user’s social media activity to refine the music selection. By mapping detected emotions to user-preferred music genres or specific songs, the system dynamically curates playlists tailored to the user’s psychological state. When users exhibit emotions such as sadness, the system references their liked content on social media to play uplifting or motivational tracks. This approach integrates emotion recognition with sentiment-based social media data, enhancing the user experience with emotionally adaptive music recommendations. The sys- tem does not require a user interface, as the music selection process is automated. Experiments demonstrate the efficacy of this approach in creating a responsive and contextually aware music recommendation ex-perience.

articleTitle: Hospital Recommendation Systems Using Decision Tree and Cosine Similarity Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Many cases have been increasingly reported mortality due to delayed medical intervention, especially due to lack of knowledge on nearby hospital provision. Addressing this critical need for effective hospital recommendation systems, this research introduces innovative approaches using advanced recommendation algorithms. Hospital recommendation systems are pivotal in enhancing access to quality healthcare by guiding individuals to suitable medical facilities. This paper explores two distinct content-based filtering methods for hospital recommendation: a decision tree classifier and cosine similarity calculations. The decision tree classifier categorizes hospitals based on features like average fees and ratings, providing a structured framework to match patient needs with hospital capabilities. Meanwhile, cosine similarity leverages hospital attributes including ratings to recommend the facilities that closely align with patient preferences. Performance evaluation of both methods includes comparing overall average relevance scores and visualizing recommendation distributions. This comparative analysis highlights each method’s strengths in delivering personalized hospital recommendations tailored to individual patient profiles. It underscores the role of tailored recommendations in optimizing healthcare delivery and enhancing patient experiences. By advancing these recommendation algorithms, this study contributes to improving healthcare accessibility and patient satisfaction.

articleTitle: Integrated Drone Solutions for Landmine Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: In hostile areas they use drones to recover landmines and mitigate conflict. This breakthrough of marrying remote controlled drone systems with ground penetrating radar means it can rapidly detect bombs buried more than 10 feet below ground. Using the deep learning networks, the drone and its sensor achieve low false positives with higher detection specificity. Drones with precise SRNs make minefield mapping and clearing much easier. This technology can be used for resolving kind: finding methods for rehabilitation with little harm to the local population.

articleTitle: Sign Language Detection in Real-Time Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Individuals with hearing and speech impairments often rely on gesture language for communication, but a lack of widespread understanding of this language among others creates significant barriers. A machine learning model that recognizes hand signals and converts them into English can help bridge this gap, facilitating communication between hearing and deaf individuals. Existing non-verbal communication identification systems, while leveraging computational learning and AI models for both single- and double-handed gestures, generally lack real-time capabilities. This research proposes a live symbolic language identification platform that uses a webcam to build a regional gesture communication dataset and TensorFlow for cross-domain learning. Despite a smaller dataset, the system targets high accuracy in recognition. Advanced technologies, including computer vision and deep learning, are applied to improve communication for deaf individuals by developing accessible technical applications and platforms. The proposed model, utilizing TensorFlow and OpenCV, aims to identify commonly used American Sign Language gestures in real time with accuracy and efficiency, including signs such as “hello,” “thanks,” “bye,” “yes,” “no,” “dad,” and “mom.”

articleTitle: Speech Therapy Assistance through Gamification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Speech therapy, or speech-language pathology, is a specialized field that helps people with communication and swallowing difficulties and break down the barriers that result from speech impediments. The goals are to improve pronunciation, strengthen the muscles used in speech, and learn to speak correctly. This work aims to bring in an effective method of phonetic training primarily focusing on children developing the capability to speak. In this therapy tool, enhanced speech is used for providing auditory feedback with a delay to instill confidence in patients, so that they can improve their speech intelligibility gradually through relearning. The phenome level conversion technique-based transformer model allows the comparison of texts derived from audio which are converted using an Automatic Speech Recognition ASR model. Pheromone transcriptions from the CMU dictionary and words from the Merriam-Webster Dictionary have been used to help this proposed algorithm. This study introduces a gamified approach to speech therapy, focusing on phonetic training for children. Utilizing a transformer-based model and ASR technology, the system offers real-time feedback to improve pronunciation and speech intelligibility. The model attains 83% accuracy in phoneme analysis, demonstrating significant improvements in user engagement and speech outcomes, making it a robust tool for speech therapy applications.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Analysis of financial distress prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: This study presents an original methodology for monetary pain expectation by coordinating half breed network examination with cutting edge AI strategies. Using a dataset obtained from Kaggle, the examination centers around grouping organizations in view of their monetary wellbeing. The objective variable, “Monetary Misery,” is ordered as sound (0) in the event that it surpasses - $\mathbf{0. 5 0}$ and monetarily upset (1) in any case. The proposed framework utilizes troupe learning techniques to improve predictive accuracy. In particular, a democratic classifier and Random Forest calculation are executed to total expectations from various models, in this manner utilizing their consolidated assets. The group approach plans to further develop order execution by decreasing overfitting and expanding power. This procedure is supposed to offer a more solid device for monetary experts and leaders to distinguish troubled organizations, subsequently helping with ideal mediation and key preparation.

articleTitle: Parkinson’s Disease Predictive Analysis Using Machine Learning and Appointment Booking
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease is a progressive neurological disorder that affects movement and can cause symptoms such as tremors, rigidity, balance issues, and difficulties in walking. Early diagnosis and intervention are crucial in managing the condition and improving patient’s quality of life. This project focuses on developing a machine learning-based system to predict the likelihood of Parkinson’s disease using various input factors. These factors include patient information, motor symptoms, vocal features extracted from audio recordings. The system integrates predictive analysis with a feature for scheduling medical appointments, allowing users to book consultations for further evaluation. Three machine learning algorithms-Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and XGBoost–were utilized to build a comprehensive prediction model. For cases where the model predicts a higher likelihood of Parkinson’s disease, it provides recommendations and facilitates follow-up appointments with healthcare professionals. The model’s performance was evaluated using accuracy metrics, with Random forest with 84.62% accuracy, the Support Vector Classifier achieving $\mathbf{89.74\%}$ accuracy and XGBoost delivering the highest accuracy at $\mathbf{94.87\%}$. This system aims to improve accessibility to healthcare, support early detection of Parkinson’s disease, and serve as a useful tool in enhancing diagnostic efficiency and patient care.

articleTitle: Pinnacle of Steganography Security with Fernet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: A novel web-based platform that securely conceals encrypted communications within digital photos by utilizing Least Significant Bit (LSB) steganography in conjunction with Fernet encryption is presented. The technology guarantees that not only is the message’s content kept private, but that its mere existence is invisible to unauthorized persons by combining these two strategies. With a React frontend and Flask-based backend, the platform has a solid architecture that produces a seamless and user-friendly interface. For maximum scalability and dependability, the system is hosted on Firebase for the frontend and Render for the backend. In the future, the platform intends to incorporate Fernet encryption for improved cryptographic security, strengthening the system against potential dangers like quantum computing. In sensitive settings where integrity and privacy are crucial, like the government, business, or personal life, this technology is especially well-suited for secure communications.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Retinal Vessel Extraction Using Multi-Scale Deep Learning and Morphological Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Retinal vessel extraction is pivotal in diagnosing and managing various ophthalmic and systemic diseases. This study introduces a novel approach that combines multi-scale deep learning with advanced morphological techniques to achieve accurate and efficient retinal vessel extraction. Our multi-scale convolutional neural network (CNN) captures both global and local vessel structures, while morphological operations refine the segmentation. Evaluations on publicly available datasets, including DRIVE and STARE, show that our method outperforms existing techniques with a vessel segmentation accuracy of 95.8%, sensitivity of 88.4%, specificity of 97.2%, and a Dice coefficient of 92.1%. The proposed approach demonstrates significant potential for clinical applications in early disease detection and monitoring, promising enhanced performance in retinal imaging tasks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security Through the Implementation of Deep Learning Techniques GRU and LSTM for Intelligent Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Anomaly-based intelligent intrusion detection systems (IDS) employ advanced algorithms and deep learning (DL) techniques to monitor network traffic, system behavior, and user activities in real-time. By creating a baseline of typical activity, these systems make it possible for them to identify any variations or anomalies that might indicate security risks. This proactive approach enhances the capability to identify and respond to emerging attack vectors that traditional signature-based systems might overlook. This paper proposes an intelligent IDS for predicting security attacks using DL techniques, specifically Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) classifiers. Initially, an input dataset is collected for data preprocessing, where raw data is transformed into a clean dataset. Data preprocessing involves checking for missing values, noisy data, and other inconsistencies before proceeding to data exploration. This step entails utilizing data visualization and statistical techniques to characterize the dataset. Following data preprocessing, the dataset undergoes feature selection to improve predictive model performance and reduce computational costs. The selected features are then classified using GRU and LSTM classifiers. Both LSTM and GRU architectures incorporate gates as an internal mechanism to control the retention or discarding of information, effectively addressing the issues of exploding and vanishing gradients. Finally, the model’s performance is evaluated based on metrics such as accuracy, recall, F1 score, and precision. The implementation is carried out using the Python programming language.

articleTitle: Thyroid Cancer Prediction Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Thyroid cancer is a common endocrine malignancy where early detection is most important for effective treatment. In this study, we propose a deep learning-based approach for thyroid cancer detection using medical images of benign, malignant, and normal thyroids. The images undergo pre-processing to enhance quality and uniformity. Feature extraction is conducted using several well-known deep learning models, including Logistic Regression, VGG16, VGG19, ResNet-50, Alex Net, and Inception V3. By leveraging the pre-trained weights from these models, we employ transfer learning techniques to fine-tune them specifically for the detection of thyroid cancer. The proposed novel method is extracted features from transfer learning model are subsequently classified using a various of machine learning algorithms, including K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), XG Boost, Decision Tree, Random Forest, AdaBoost, Logistic Regression, and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Each classifier’s performance is assessed based on accuracy. Our results show that combining deep learning feature extraction with traditional classifiers is effective for thyroid cancer detection. By comparing the classification accuracies, we identify the best-performing model and classifier combination for this task. This highlights the potential of deep learning and machine learning integration to improve the accuracy and reliability of thyroid cancer diagnosis, contributing to more efficient clinical practices.

articleTitle: EEG Interpretation for Healthcare: Emotional Analysis Using GRU and Activity Tracking with Epilepsy Diagnosis using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: This paper deals with the design of a multi-functional system for EEG signal interpretation, with emphasis on emotional analysis and monitoring activities along with epilepsy diagnosis. The primary module is realized using the deep learning-based Gated Recurrent Units model in which EEG signals fall under several modes of the emotional state, like Sleep/Unconscious, Calm, and Active/Stress. We include a preprocessing step using FFT that will extract features from the frequency domain to enhance model performance. We also use Keras Tuner for hyperparameter tuning, as in the number of units in GRU and the learning rate, to get 83% accuracy. The second module for this system is a classifier using a Random Forest for monitoring activity and diagnosis of epilepsy. 11 activities from EEG signals, including walking and sitting are recognized during the day while determining whether they are epileptic or not. The extraction of statistical features along with frequency domain characteristics from the EEG data indicates an exceptionally high efficacy of Random Forest in the diagnosis of epilepsy, which has gained an accuracy rate of 83%. The datasets that will be utilized will comprise EEG recordings from healthy subjects and those who have a diagnosed case of epilepsy. This methodology utilizes statistical and frequency characteristics for identifying intricate patterns and, therefore, making possible upgraded predictions of emotional conditions and medical diagnoses.

articleTitle: Object detection and tracking for Personal Protective Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: This paper focuses on real-time detection and tracking techniques for Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) in workplace scenarios. Based on the critical characteristics of efficiency, the potential solution addresses the identification and tracking of PPE for safety and anti-injury purposes by leveraging advanced underlying technologies. Therefore, this paper presents a real-world applicability, efficiency, and reliability in PPE monitoring using YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once version 8). The overall approach of the system includes data cleaning, model learning, and deployment. The efficiency of the proposed model is evaluated by performance indicators precision, recall, etc. The findings thus support the applicability of YOLOv8 in real-scenario settings with reliable PPE identification and monitoring. The accuracy achieved with the proposed model is ${9 4 \%}$.

articleTitle: Classification, Segmentation and Quantification of acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells in the bone marrow
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Cancer is a type of disease in which abnormal cells flourish and penetrate adjacent tissues, then spread to other parts of the body via the blood and lymph system. This abnormality results in DNA alterations in the bone marrow, which give rise to malignant cells in haematologic malignancies like leukaemia. This results in the abnormal production of white blood cells, where cancerous cells proliferate more quickly than healthy cells, compromising the ability of healthy cells to carry out their regular tasks, including fighting infections, distributing oxygen, and clotting blood. The primary objective was to create an efficient model that could classify the given microscopic image of bone marrow containing cancerous cells or not. If the image is classified as cancerous then the model will segment the cancer cells over the normal cells, in addition the model will quantify the presence of malignant cells to measure the spread in the blood. Segmentation and quantification along with the classification will provide better explainability to the model, thus to achieve this both the image processing techniques and the deep learning model are used to develop the Classification, Segmentation and Quantification (CSQ) of acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells in the bone marrow. The model is evaluated using the metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, specificity and F1score. Experimental results showed that the model performs well when compared to the existing methods.

articleTitle: A Multi-Layer Encryption and Anomaly Detection Framework for Securing SCTP Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP)is an efficient protocol that can replace TCP/UDP in future.Eventhough it is initially used in IP networks, it performs better in multitasking and multi-homing environments because of its incredible features.Due to this, SCTP gains attention by the researchers for utilizing it in data communication similar to TCP/UDP.However, its popularity is hindered due to several security issues like DoS attack, chunk bundling, lack of confidentiality, man-in -the middle attack etc.Therefore a secure and reliable data communication using SCTP is essential. The research focuses on proposing a steganographic algorithm to analyze and verify the hidden areas in SCTP, aiming to detect unauthorized access. The proposed method enhances the integrity and security of SCTP for data transmission compared to existing methods and achieves a reasonable throughput and delay.

articleTitle: ECG Arrhythmia Classification Using CNN-BiLSTM Models for Enhanced Diagnostic Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Arrhythmias, or irregular heart rhythms, are common cardiovascular disorders that can cause severe health complications if not identified and treated properly. Reliable diagnosis is essential to manage and treat arrhythmias effectively, with ECG (Electrocardiogram) recordings serving as a critical tool for observing the heart’s electrical patterns. The intricate and fluctuating patterns within ECG signals make it challenging to accurately classify various arrhythmia types. Traditional arrhythmia classification methods, including manual ECG interpretation and rule-based algorithms, often lack precision and scalability, as they struggle to capture the complex temporal patterns in ECG signals and require extensive manual input. To overcome these challenges, the proposed solution integrates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) networks. The propounded hybrid method effectively captures both spatial and temporal features in ECG signals, improving the accuracy of arrhythmia classification. By combining CNN for feature extraction and BiLSTM for capturing sequential dependencies, the model enhances diagnostic precision. It enables more reliable and faster arrhythmia detection, supporting real-time clinical decision-making and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Efficient Path planning for Automated Guided Vehicles in Intelligent Logistics System using Double Q-learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: In logistics systems, Multiple Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) have been extensively used for transportation. While determining the path by AGVs, Conflict-free route planning is a major research challenge. This study builds a novel efficient path-finding model using a Double QLearning reinforcement algorithm (DQL) to improve the efficiency of multi-robot path planning. Initially, training has been performed using a double Q-learning algorithm to learn the solutions to route-planning problems quickly. This algorithm determines the optimal route for AGV to reach the destination based on rewards without collision and ensures minimal transfer time. AGV selects the action based on Q-table values. Results show that this Double Q-learning path-finding algorithm executes faster than existing algorithms such as the $A^{*}$ algorithm, Conflict Based Search and Autonomous Distributed Route Planning Method (ADRPM) and reduces total picking distance by 5% than other methods. This DQL path finding algorithm has been executed with less computation time than ADRPM by nearly 57%.

articleTitle: Women Safety Night Patrolling Robot Using Raspberry Pi 3
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The Women Safety Night Patrolling Robot project offers a cutting-edge solution to women’s night-time safety issues. Utilizing a Raspberry Pi camera, USB microphone, and ultrasonic sensor, this self-governing robot is outfitted with cutting-edge features to improve security and monitoring protocols. The robot can identify and evaluate audio signals thanks to the USB microphone, enabling it to identify any early threats or distress cries. The ultrasonic sensor ensures safe travel through various situations by making obstacle recognition and avoidance easier. Furthermore, the Raspberry Pi camera provides visual monitoring in real-time, enabling data transfer and remote surveillance. The Women Safety Night Patrolling Robot offers a comprehensive solution to improve women’s safety during night patrols by integrating these components, making the environment safer and more secure for everyone.

articleTitle: Conversational Interface for Textual and Visual Data Interpretation using customized CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel multimodal chatbot for continuous text and vision processing to overcome the constraints of current text-only based interacting agents. While early systems like ELIZA (1966) and PARRY (1972) introduced basic conversational abilities, modern chatbots remain largely text based. To address this difficulty, we introduce “Salvatore” chatbot comprised of a uniquely designed CNN system to quickly analyze the text and images. For text context, we employ the Lemmatization and Tokenization methods, and in the case of images, Gaussian fluctuation, convolutions, binarization theorems, Canny edge detection, gradients, resizing dimensions, and pixels area average algorithms. All the functions tested on the model returned the expected results with 85% accuracy and 80% precision in case of object identification tasks. It operated without considerable obstacles, no lag time as well as sign of regression is observed across various versions. Further, fine-tuning builds the interactive ability continuously, and as such, this chatbot provides reliable interfaces for multi-modal dialogues.

articleTitle: IOT Botnet Detection using a Hybrid of CNN-LSTM with Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The exponential growth of IoT devices has intensified the threat of botnet attacks, creating an urgent need for secure and adaptive detection solutions. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are employed to extract spatial features, while Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models record temporal dependencies in network traffic. A blockchain ledger continuously logs all the model parameters and performance matrices by hashing them with SHA-256 thus making the data verifiable. The blockchain layout provides a decentralized, unaltered record of model performance ensuring transparency and reliability in the botnet detection systems. This study integrates the CNN-LSTM model with blockchain technology to enhance the effectiveness and reliability of the botnet detection system in IoT environments. The model is trained in the IoT-23 datasets using SMOTE for data balancing and reducing false positive rates. This study finds that the implementation of CNN-LSTM model without sampling to be the most effective giving an accuracy of 0.999.

articleTitle: Spoken Language Translation Using wav2vec, mBart and Wavenet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Spoken language translation has become a critical component of human-computer interaction, enabling cross-lingual communication in various domains such as business, education, and healthcare. However, creating an efficient end-to-end system that accurately converts speech from one language to another presents significant challenges. These include the accurate recognition of spoken words, translating them into a target language while maintaining contextual meaning, and finally synthesizing the translated text into natural-sounding speech.In this research, we propose a comprehensive spoken language translation system utilizing three state-of-the-art technologies: wav2vec 2.0 for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), mBart for Machine Translation (MT), and Wavenet for Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. Wav2vec 2.0, a self-supervised learning model, is employed to transcribe spoken input into text, achieving high accuracy in speech recognition by learning from large amounts of unlabeled audio data. The recognized text is then passed to mBart, a multilingual sequence-to-sequence model, which translates the transcribed text into the desired target language. Finally, the translated text is synthesized into human-like speech using Wavenet, a deep generative model that produces highly natural and intelligible speech from text. Our system was evaluated on a diverse dataset containing multiple languages, with emphasis on translation between English and other languages. The performance of the system was measured using standard metrics such as Word Error Rate (WER) for ASR, BLEU score for MT, and Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for speech synthesis quality. The experimental results demonstrate that our system delivers high accuracy in speech recognition and translation, and generates natural and fluent speech in the target language, making it suitable for real-world applications in multilingual communication. This research highlights the potential of combining wav2vec, mBart, and Wavenet to create an efficient and scalable spoken language translation pipeline.

articleTitle: Enhanced Multi-Class Skin Cancer Classification Using Attention-Based Convolutional Neural Network with HOG Feature Extraction and ROI-Centred Pre-processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Skin cancer, a common increasingly prevalent disease, encompasses eight distinct diagnostic categories, posing significant challenges for dermatologists due to the highly similar visual characteristics of these categories. Traditional diagnostic accuracy for multiclass skin cancer detection ranges between 70% and 99%, often falling short in multi-class scenarios compared to binary classification performance. To address this, an Attention-Based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) designed this research for multiclass skin cancer classification. The proposed work begins with a robust pre-processing stage involving Min-Max scaling for normalization and Region of Interest (ROI) cropping, which effectively reduces computational complexity. RGB images are transformed into single-channel grayscale, and ROI cropping emphasizes relevant regions, aiding in the model’s localization capability. Following feature extraction, Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) is used to capture important material details, improving the quality of input features. The classification stage utilizes the Attention based CNN to focus on diagnostically relevant areas, thereby improving classification accuracy across multiple skin cancer types. The proposed method demonstrates a significant improvement in diagnostic performance, offering a promising solution for efficient and accurate cancer classification. The accuracy of the proposed method is achieved as 96% and the specificity is of 0.92.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of LSTM Classification Model from GLCM with Lion Optimization Algorithm Features for Melanoma Identification from Skin Cancer Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Melanoma skin cancer is one of the most dangerous types of skin cancers that if not diagnosed and treated in the early stages can lead to death. This paper examines the detection of melanoma through GLCM feature extraction for the identification of patterns. We conduct a performance analysis on LOA based LSTM classifier and MSA based LSTM classifier. The accuracy of the LOA based classifier which is 97.49% is more than the accuracy of MSA based classifier which is 95.89% with a less error margin of $\mathbf{2. 5 5 \%}$. These results illustrate the promise that the latest machine learning approaches have in the promotion of early detection of malignant melanoma, which is essential to improve health care delivery to patients.

articleTitle: Astroturfing Exposed: Uncovering the Role of Astroturfing in Shaping Trust and Engagement Online
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Astroturfing is the practice of simulating widespread grassroots support to manipulate public opinion, and it poses a severe threat to online trust. Astroturfing creates fake campaigns that look like genuine opinions. This misleads people into believing there is broad support for specific ideas. This can trick audiences into trusting brands or ideas that aren’t genuinely valuable, affecting how they make decisions and interact online. These tactics are particularly harmful when they take advantage of trusted platforms, eroding users’ trust and potentially leading to misinformed and biased decisions. This study investigates how astroturfed messages can impact public opinion and engagement, particularly among loyal mobile brand users. By collecting data on user ratings before and after exposure to a carefully crafted astroturfed message, the aim was to measure how strategic messaging and astroturfing can shift perceptions and influence brand loyalty. This approach involves a paired t-test and delta analysis to quantify changes in ratings, specifically focusing on areas like Security and Value for Money Features. It was proved through statistical insights and analysis that astroturfing can erode user trust, offering a systematic approach to understanding opinion shifts and manipulation. The findings highlight the need for enhanced detection tools to combat astroturfing effectively, ensuring that online interactions remain authentic and trustworthy. As astroturfing techniques grow more sophisticated, identifying and mitigating these manipulative practices is critical to preserving public trust. Future research should explore advanced detection methodologies and adaptive frameworks to stay ahead of these tactics, safeguarding the integrity of online discourse in an era of rapid digital communication.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks in Breast Cancer Diagnosis: An Integrated Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Breast cancer is always the top most reason for the increase in death rate of women. Therefore advancements in diagnosing technique is very much needed, so that the breast cancer can be detected without false positives or false negatives for clinicians to take necessary action at the earlier stage. Deep learning technique like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) has become a very successful tool in medical imaging specifically for breast cancer diagnosis. Imaging modalities like mammogram, ultrasound and MRI has become the primary source of breast cancer diagnosis. This paper proposed the idea of integrating multiple CNN architectures with mammogram datasets for training the model and make use of ensemble technique to detect the breast cancer during the testing phase. This Integrated CNN model is expected to achieve higher detection accuracy with less false positive rate.

articleTitle: A Smart Pill Dispenser with Real Time Alerts, Remote Access, and Enhanced Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Because chronic illnesses are becoming more common and the aging population requires better drug administration, a Smart Pill Dispenser was created. This device aims to improve drug adherence by monitoring medication intake, giving reminders, and automating the pill distribution process. The Smart Pill Dispenser has an easy-to-use interface for effortless interaction, a microprocessor for system administration, and sensors to detect pill removal. The device also has remote monitoring features that let caregivers keep an eye on patients’ adherence in real time. The combination of these functions guarantees that medications are taken on schedule, lowering the possibility of missing doses and enhancing patient outcomes overall.

articleTitle: TransNet: A Hybrid Deep Learning Architecture Combining CNNs and Transformers for Enhanced Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: CNNs excel at extracting local features, such as edges, textures and fine details, through the use of convolutional filters. Well-known models like U-Net, V-Net and DeepLab have demonstrated significant success in medical image segmentation due to their hierarchical feature extraction and their efficient processing of both 2D and 3D medical images. However, CNNs often face challenges in capturing long-range dependencies, which can limit their effectiveness in modeling complex anatomical structures. Transformers, originally developed for natural language processing tasks have recently gained importance in computer vision because of their ability to capture long-range dependencies through self-attention mechanisms. TransNet is a hybrid architecture that combines the strengths of CNNs and Transformers to address the complexities of medical image segmentation. By capturing both local and global context, it enhances accuracy and effectively manages complex anatomical structures.

articleTitle: SignChatAI-Generative AI for Deaf-and-Mute Community using Indian Sign Language(ISL)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: SignChatAI is a advanced generative AI chatbot aimed at revolutionizing communication for deaf-and-mute individuals in India through the use of Indian Sign Language (ISL). This paper addresses the need for advanced communication solutions that facilitate interactions between the deaf community and hearing individuals, thereby fostering inclusivity. By equipping deaf-and-mute individuals with this AI-driven communication assistant, SignChatAI aims to create a more inclusive society, where users can communicate freely and confidently. This initiative aims to improve the quality of life for its users and promote participation in social, educational, and professional environments. Overall, our proposed SignChatAI represents a significant advancement in bridging the communication gaps and promote equitable opportunities for interaction within the deaf-and-mute community.

articleTitle: Fig Leaf Disease Prediction and Severity Estimation Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Fig leaf diseases are among the major causes of crop loss. Better methods for detection and further increased accuracy in the estimation of the severity of the disease are demanded. In basis of what is previously researched, this project continues with not just the identification of the disease but also the identification of the level of infections. Having a large dataset of 1,871 images that comprises 971 healthy samples and 900 infected samples, the analysis will be more elaborate to determine the disease in comparison with previous estimates. We have used two deep learning models - GoogLeNet and AlexNet with outstanding performance in preceding research to make reliable predictions on leaf diseases. The novel contribution of our work is estimating the disease severity with the help of Convolutional Neural Networks that could extract features and classify disease. For the estimation of the disease severity, we will use the VGG16 model to be able to categorize the infection severity into three classes- healthy, mild, and high. The diseases addressed in this paper are Cerotelium fici (fig rust) and Fig mosaic disease.The goal is to offer a comprehensive tool designed to identify diseases in fig crops and assess their severity for fig farmers and the researcher so that timely disease management strategies could be undertaken. This integrated approach not only aids in taking prompt intervention but also contributes significantly toward sustainable agriculture by reducing adverse impacts on fig leaf diseases.

articleTitle: AIoT-Based Water Quality Monitoring System for Enhanced Mud Crab Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Maintaining optimal water quality is fundamental to the success of aquaculture, particularly in mud crab farming. Parameters such as $\mathrm{p H}$, temperature, alkalinity, and nitrates are traditionally checked manually, which can lead to errors and significant losses in aquaculture. These issues can be overcome with an IoT-based water quality monitoring system, automating real-time tracking and analysis of these parameters. The system uses multiple sensors to gather essential data, which is sent to the cloud for detailed analysis and storage via a microcontroller. An easy-to-use dashboard visualizes the data, and an alert system notifies farmers when conditions deviate from optimal levels, enabling timely actions. This IoT approach significantly improves sustainability and efficiency in mud crab farming, leading to better productivity and higher profitability. The system is highly efficient, providing live insights that improve water management practices within aquaculture, while also reducing costs associated with traditional laboratory testing and offering continuous, real-time monitoring for farmers. The system monitors parameters such as $\mathrm{p H}(7.5-9.0)$, temperature (25– $35^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$), dissolved oxygen ($\gt5 \mathrm{ppm}$), salinity (10-25 ppt), and turbidity (Secchi disc $20-\mathrm{3 0} \mathrm{~ c m}$), all of which are continuously tracked to ensure optimal water quality for sustainable aquaculture.

articleTitle: Design of Anti-Theft Recognition System Using Kanade-Lucas-Tomasi based feature extraction method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The rampant issue of vehicle theft on a global scale demands more effective security solutions. Traditional methods like keys and alarms have shown limitations in deterring theft. This paper presents a novel approach utilizing face recognition technology to authenticate authorized users of vehicles. By employing a Raspberry Pi circuit and a camera, the system captures and registers the owner’s facial features. Once registered, only authorized individuals can initiate the vehicle’s operation. In the event an unauthorized user attempts to access the vehicle, the system conducts a facial scan and verifies it against the registered profile. If a match is not found, access is denied, and an alarm is triggered.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact System For Identifying Driver Attention Lapses To Improve Traffic Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The rise in road accidents worldwide, driven by driver distractions, has led to numerous injuries, property damage, and fatalities. To combat this issue, it is vital to monitor and analyze driver behavior while on the road. This study presents an affordable distraction detection model utilizing the ReLU-BiLSTM framework based on Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), integrated with an attention mechanism. The model processes input images sourced from public datasets and employs preprocessing techniques, including resizing and color format adjustments. By effectively identifying distractions such as cell phone usage, conversations, eating, drowsiness, and lapses in concentration, the ReLU-BiLSTM RNN demonstrates its capability. The attention mechanism allows the model to prioritize critical information, enabling real-time detection. Comparative evaluations with advanced methods reveal significant improvements in accuracy, recall, specificity, precision, and $F 1$ score. This research emphasizes the model’s potential to greatly enhance road safety by providing timely alerts or interventions to address the dangers of distracted driving.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Security Architecture for 6G Networks: A Federated Learning and Multi-Agent Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The coming 6G network is expected to provide better connectivity and network performance but will generate new security challenges. In this paper, we demonstrate a novel technological solution to address the security challenges of the 6G network by combining artificial intelligence with federated learning and multi-agent systems. Federated learning enables the distributed learning of data in the network without revealing the data’s confidentiality. In the meantime, multi-agent systems use intelligent autonomous agents that are equipped to quickly identify and handle any potential threat in a variety of network environments. In combination, these technologies constitute a system-on-system (SoS) type, end-to-end security architecture that is modular, dynamic, and self-contained, consistent with ultra-reliability requirements, high device count in the terahertz regime, and wide-ranging traffic data found in 6G. Through simulations and case studies, this paper demonstrates that the proposed method significantly enhances the accuracy of threat detection and response, as well as improves the efficiency of threat mitigation and the overall security compliance of the network for a more secure and robust 6G environment.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Malware Detection: A Comprehensive Review of Visual, Textual and Network Traffic Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: IoT devices, constrained by limited resources and weak security measures, are highly vulnerable to malware at- tacks. This review examines malware detection methods using textual, visual, and network traffic features, with experiments fo- cused on network traffic data. Feature extraction techniques such as correlation analysis, eXtreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost), and the Firefly algorithm were applied to machine learning models, including logistic regression, random forest, Adaptive Boosting(AdaBoost), and perceptron. Results highlight the poten- tial of these approaches for resource-constrained environments.

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning for Enhanced Software Defect Prediction and Quality Assurance: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The evolution of software engineering practices has heightened the emphasis on quality assurance, particularly in defect prediction and testing methodologies. Traditional approaches often fall short in addressing the complexities of modern software systems, prompting the integration of advanced technologies such as deep learning and machine learning. Recent research highlights the development of robust models for predicting defect density, which effectively tackle issues of data sparsity, alongside the introduction of specialized validation frameworks for AI-driven software that utilize innovative testing methods. Additionally, advancements in automated testing practices, including the use of large language models for test case generation and ensemble machine learning for bug classification, underscore the critical role of efficient maintenance in ensuring software quality. Furthermore, novel frameworks for validating unsupervised learning systems bridge user expectations with system performance evaluations. Collectively, these contributions reveal a trend towards leveraging cutting-edge methodologies to address the multifaceted challenges of software quality, emphasizing the need for adaptive and innovative strategies as software systems continue to evolve.

articleTitle: Sign Language Production Using Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Sign language is vital for communication among the deaf and hard of hearing, but a lack of interpreters limits accessibility. This research utilizes Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), specifically a Conditional GAN (CGAN) based on the pix2pix model, to generate sign language gestures from skeletal pose data. Keypoints extracted through OpenPose are converted into realistic body movements, with a focus on fluidity. While the CGAN successfully generates natural movements, replicating detailed hand gestures remains challenging. Future work will aim to improve hand gesture accuracy and integrate real-time speech recognition to enhance accessibility.

articleTitle: Smart Signature-based Intrusion Analysis System with Pre-Scaled Learning for Large Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: [Intrusion detection systems are crucial elements of contemporary cybersecurity methods. They identify unauthorized actions that jeopardize integrity, confidentiality, and availability of information systems. This work extends analysis of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), comparing Signature-based Intrusion Detection Systems (SIDS) and Anomaly-based Intrusion Detection Systems (AIDS) in the context of threat model recognition. It further examines the integration of machine learning into an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) to enhance the detection of unknown threats, anomaly identification, and scalability. The study compares several clustering algorithms, specifically K-Means and DBSCAN, and presents a comparative analysis that demonstrates K-Means is more effective in differentiating benign from malicious data. It encompasses the installation of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) across several platforms, including cloud and host-based systems, and outlines approaches such as monitoring data utilization, registry modifications, and analyzing TCP dumps for intrusion detection. In the end, it delineates future directions, emphasizing advancements in AI and machine learning, quantum resistance, and privacy-preserving techniques to address the escalating security threats.]

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms and Datasets for Detecting Cyberbullying on Social Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Cyberbullying is defined as sharing of undesirable material in the cyberspace, primarily- the use of the social sites that instigate hostility and create feelings of hatred among the individuals. Another increasing threat due to increase use of internet-based communication is cyberbullying especially on the site such as Twitter. Different ML and NLP approaches including support vector machine (SVM), Naϊve bayes, Random Forest, and logistic regression is employed to detect cyberbul Bullivating. These methods for supervised learning mine patterns in text and image, allowing computers to promptly flag risky interactions. Some of these approaches also utilizes OCR for the identification of image-based bullying. Consequently, the objective of this research is to identify the correct algorithm and dataset for improving the identification of cyberbullying and solving the problem that manifests itself in the steady increase in cases of this type of bullying.

articleTitle: Utilizing Blockchain Technology for Financial Services in Parallel, Distributed, and Grid Computing Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Application of blockchain in financial services has opened new ways of efficiency in transaction processing, assets management and security. The application of parallel, distributed, and grid computing with blockchain in improving the functionality of financial services like real time financial transactions, high frequency trading, portfolio and risk analysis is examined in this paper. It has been ascertained that namely parallel and distributed computing together with blockchain are the most suitable for facing increasing needs in data in the sphere of financial services. It also investigates the use of grid computing frameworks and their effects on the correspondingly balanced flows of medium amongst multiple systems. Various issues such as security, privacy violations, and adherence to the law are also reviewed, and existing prospects for developing through smart contracts and consensus mechanisms using blockchain. Exploring how some of the most successful pilot use-cases of blockchain are applicable for future growth in the financial services industry offers insights into how blockchain will soon enter mainstream as a disruptive technology in the broader global financial sector.

Author Keywords: Applied to banking and financial industries

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection using Feedforward Neural Network for Enhancing Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The rapid development of Internet of Things (IoT) has altered how people engage with their surroundings and communicate with one another. Network security is becoming more complicated as a result of these advancements. As IoT networks grow, data security and integrity are becoming more crucial. This study presents a method for evaluating Feedforward Neural Network (FFNN) a deep learning model’s classification performance to solve security problems. The UNSW-NB15 dataset is well recognized for being a perfect for the DL-based intrusion detection system. The FFNN model demonstrates its ability to identify and reduce the risks related to network anomalies with an accuracy of 96.48%. The F1 score, recall, accuracy and precision are used to assess the DL approach. By improving network resilience and dependability, this study contributes to a sense of trust in the expanding world of networked devices.

articleTitle: Voice assistance to blind people by detection of surrounding objects, activities, and humans
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Various systems were developed to assist those with vision impairments and enhance their standard of life. Regrettably, the majority of these systems have restricted functionality. We decided to build a model that detects all possible surrounding things and guides them through voice description. Our main objective is to detect the obstacles in the person’s pathway and warn them using voice description [1]. The model can assist blind people from the surrounding obstacles which exist in their pathway. The primary goal of the model is to identify the nearby obstacles - vehicles, animals, persons, objects, etc, in the person’s pathway and guide or warn them using voice description. Our proposed system integrates advanced real-time obstacle detection and voice-guided navigation using a novel combination of DepthNet module with convolutional LSTM layers, enhancing spatial context awareness compared to traditional models. This approach, along with fine-tuning on diverse datasets such as MS COCO and BDD100K, ensures robust performance in varied environments and conditions. The real-time guidance capability is further improved by the integration of optical flow algorithms, which accurately estimate motion in dynamic scenes. This comprehensive solution significantly enhances the assistive technology for those with visual impairments.

articleTitle: Handwriting Analysis for Personality Trait Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Handwriting analysis has indeed been a relatively well-researched medium to bring out the various facets of an individual’s personality. A personality prediction system based on deep learning for handwriting is proposed. Conventionally, handwriting was seen as an output of personality. Personality characteristics in terms of Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Neuroticism, and Openness are characterized and classified with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for the evaluation of handwriting samples. This project applies image preprocessing techniques on a given dataset of samples of labeled handwriting to look for relevant features by resizing, contour detection, and edge detection. The output from these features goes into the CNN model to classify the handwriting into personality trait categories. Data augmentation is used in order to enhance model generalization, and performance is evaluated using metrics such as accuracy, precision, and recall. It addresses the key challenges, including variations in handwriting styles and noisy data, and addresses the issue of robust preprocessing of data and architecture design for improved prediction accuracies. The system demonstrated a promising prediction related to personality traits, indicating the feasibility of deep learning and computer vision techniques for the purpose of psychological as- sessment through handwriting analysis. This approach might be further refined for practical applications in disciplines like human resources, psychological profiling, and personal development.

articleTitle: Integrating Classification, Segmentation, LLM, and Attention Maps for Advanced Histopathological Image Analysis in Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Lung Cancer remains as a dangerous challenge to the health industry, which require a innovation for a early detection and individualize treatment.This study presents a deep learning method designed to classify and segment lung cancer-related histopathology images. The approach combines state-of-the-art technique like Grad-CAM for visual explanations. It integrates multiple models tailored for distinct objectives, such as image segmentation and classification tasks. To enhance its functionality even more, the model was integrated with large language model (LLM). The dataset used includes lung cancer patients’ histopathological scans, which provide a huge amount of information for precise diagnosis and treatment planning. Thorough testing and evaluation show that the model performs better in accurately determining lung cancer subtypes and segmenting areas of interest within the tissue samples. In addition, the model becomes easier to understand and performs better when attention strategies are implemented.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Security Measures for Mobile Phones: Protecting Against Information Theft
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Now a days mobile phones becomes one of the single point of contact with all the real world activities like cash payment, media sharing, data storing, etc., to secure our mobile devices from any unsecure connection is the major challenges, especially for naive user. If the mobile devices were compromised by any means then it would be huge loss for the user. Ransomeware, DoS, Phishing etc, these were not only the major attacks happening in real world, out of this, there were an untold common mobile device attacks is information exploitation i.e stealing the user information by sending malicious code into the user mobile phone. Information like user’s banking credentials, personal images/videos, any confidential documents, personal chats etc were common things to be compromised by the third party attackers. In this paper we suggest and recommend some security measures to safe guard the sensitive data from attackers for the common man point of view.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Property Transactions Through Integration of Blockchain and AES Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: In the conventional land registration system of India, intermediaries, typically brokers, facilitate property transactions by handling the assembly and submission of physical documents for registration with government offices. However, this process is susceptible to document loss or tampering, as intermediaries possess the authority to access and alter paperwork. Our proposed solution involves the integration of smart contracts and Innovative Resistance technology, offering a more efficient, secure, and decentralized approach to land registration. By leveraging hyper ledger concepts, our system ensures transparency, integrity, and portability in transactions, thereby mitigating risks associated with corruption and fraud. This innovative system streamlines processes, eliminating the need for intermediaries and reducing the potential for document manipulation or loss. By relying on blockchain technology, it enhances the efficiency and reliability of land registration procedures, addressing long-standing challenges inherent in the traditional system. Blockchain is a peer-to-peer decentralized distributed Hyperledger technology that works without the use of a middleman third party, making the records of any digital asset transparent and immutable.

articleTitle: Vision Transformer-Based Computer-Aided Diagnosis System for Histopathological Image Classification in Lung and Colon Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: It is important for early accurate diagnosis of colon and lung cancer in order to increase patient survival rates. In this work, we attempted to use the Vision Transformers (ViTs) to solve the challenge of categorizing the histopathological images of lung and colon tissues. We finetuned a pretrained ViT model on a dataset of more than a thousand images of Colon Adenocarcinoma, Colon Benign Tissue, Lung Adenocarcinoma, Lung Benign Tissue, and Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma. Regarding the methodology, the approach involved data manipulation and expansion and modification of the classifier’s head of the ViT model. The model was trained with a batch size of 64 and 10 epochs. Adam was chosen as the optimizer of option, and its learning rate had been set at 0.01, along with the CrossEntropyLoss function. Finally, the model was 100% accurate for validation and test sets as well. The very impressive result of the Vision Transformers as evidenced in this experimental result of this study points to possible realization of revamped healthcare system for the diagnostic analysis of medical images for carcinogenic growth in the future research and developmental work in the field of automated cancer detection.

articleTitle: Advanced Surveillance System for Public Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: In recent years, the necessity for a sophisticated monitoring system to guarantee public safety has grown more apparent due to the quick urbanization and rising population density in public areas. Despite being widely utilized everywhere, current closed-circuit television (CCTV) systems frequently rely too much on human oversight for monitoring and responding and are unable to detect threats in real time. An advanced surveillance system is presented in this study with the goal of overcoming the drawbacks of conventional methods. Our system uses intelligent deep learning algorithms for crowd density estimation and management, immediate crime prevention, and sophisticated anomaly identification. This method reduces the need for human operators while increasing the speed and accuracy of threat identification, increasing the overall effectiveness of surveillance operations. By using real-world testing, we offer a thorough assessment of the system’s performance and show its benefits over competing systems. The study also looks at ways to expand the system’s capabilities in the future, such as better anomaly detection, privacy-preserving techniques, and the incorporation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices. This study advances the creation of AI-powered public safety solutions, providing a scalable and effective answer to today’s urban problems.

articleTitle: Multivariate Temporal Forecasting for Preterm Cardiorespiratory Vital Monitoring using Multihead Autoformer Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Preterm neonates admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) require continuous monitoring of cardiorespiratory vitals to prevent life-threatening complications. This study aims to construct a Multivariate Temporal Forecasting model using Multihead Autocorrelated Autoformer (MAA) to forecast pulse rate and oxygen saturation. Forecasting the cardiorespiratory vitals for preterm neonates improves clinical outcomes in the NICU by enabling timely interventions. The MAA model adopts an encoder-decoder architecture for effectively capturing complex temporal dependencies and patterns in data. The encoder learns from past sequences by processing historical data, while the decoder utilizes this learned information to make accurate future predictions. The model uses autocorrelation attention, which enhances its ability to learn and predict by focusing on significant temporal relationships. The presented work is experimented with the historical data observed from preterm neonates admitted at NICU. The results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with mean absolute percentage (MAPE) of 0.536 and 0.72 in 24 seconds frame for pulse rate and oxygen saturation respectively.

articleTitle: Companion Recognition System for Amnesia Affected Persons
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Recogni is an AI-based application designed for the purpose of enhancing the quality for individuals who are suffering from amnesia and other memory-related challenges. This application addresses key challenges in memory management, daily task organization, and social integration through features like geofencing reminders, family sharing, and interactive memory aids and turns out to be a good companion for them. To protect user data, recogni’s progressive development integrates advanced functions such as location-based notes, voice-controlled reminders, and multi-language support which are all reinforced by robust security measures. Wearable device integration, predictive analytics, and emergency assistance, are promised to be added in the ongoing development, making Recogni a versatile tool for memory care [1].

articleTitle: Advanced Chat Application Integrating Machine Learning For Sentimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The “Advanced Chat Application Integrating Machine Learning for Sentimental Analysis” is a progressive interface that utilizes machine learning (ML) algorithm to analyze user’s interaction and offer compatibility services with emotional intelligence in real-time. This platform offers the chat user an intelligent map of a comprehensive communication interface with the ability to also complete the human ability in the sense of the differentiation between emotions where it will show empathy based on the context of the user. By the implementation of sentiment analysis feature, the chat application is able to identify the emotions as happy, sad, angry or neutral that people portray when in a conversational mode of text. This is made possible by natural language processing (NLP) encoding using the artificial intelligence models that enjoy the capacity to determine the emotional content of the text messages by virtue of deep learning algorithms which were trained on large data. Therefore, the sentiment detection is able to increase the level of participation, improve on the services offered to patrons, and most importantly, the identification of symptoms of mental disorders in their early stages.

articleTitle: Collision Avoidance System in Autonomous Vehicles Using YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Collision avoidance systems are vital for improving the safety and efficiency of autonomous vehicles, particularly in preventing accidents caused by human errors such as delayed reactions, incorrect time-to-collision (TTC) estimation, and poor judgment during overtaking maneuvers. As the field of autonomous driving continues to evolve, there is a growing demand for fully automated vehicles capable of intelligently interacting with their environment to minimize human intervention while ensuring comfort and safety. In this study, we present a comprehensive collision avoidance system that makes use of cutting-edge computer vision techniques, such as Canny edge detection for lane detection and the YOLOv4 model for real-time object detection and distance calculation. Canny edge detection guarantees accurate lane recognition, which is essential for safe navigation in a variety of driving settings, while YOLOv4 improves the system’s capacity to precisely detect, classify, and track objects. The technology also uses sensor fusion and deep learning to forecast how nearby objects would behave. Distance estimation is used to generate commands, and warnings like “danger, you are going to collide” are sent out to cause quick remedial action. The system’s performance is assessed both during the day and at night in a variety of driving situations, including highway, rural, and urban settings. Accuracy measures for lane detection, distance estimates, and object identification are used to gauge effectiveness. High accuracy in object identification, distance estimation, and lane recognition is demonstrated by the results, allowing for prompt danger detection and command creation to prevent any collisions. In order to create a dependable and expandable collision avoidance system for autonomous cars, this study emphasizes the need of combining YOLOv4, Canny edge detection, and command generation.

articleTitle: A Real-Time AI-Driven Surgical Monitoring Platform Using Robotics, 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (3D-CNNs), and Bayesian Optimization for Enhanced Precision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: In this work proposed an AI powered surgical monitoring platform to enhance robotic precision-made using 3DCNNs and Bayesian optimization. For example, real time tracking of tools and tissue identification can be used to improve the accuracy and efficiency of complex robot assisted surgeries. 3DCNNs combined with Bayesian optimization to build a real-time ai platform. This will enhance the precision of robotically assisted surgery by improving such features as surgical tool tracking and tissue recognition, which are critically important parameters for decision-making during complex surgeries. A 3D-CNN is employed to automatically learn discriminative spatiotemporal features from high resolution 3D medical images. By fine tuning the model parameters using Bayesian Optimization, tool tracking and tissue classification accuracy are improved. Surgeons receive immediate feedback in critical surgical settings. The use of Bayesian optimization helped increase the accuracy of our platform by 7.6% in achieving an overall user validation rate at a staggering $\mathbf{9 9. 5 0 \%}$. Reduced latency to 180 MS for real-time tool tracking and tissue identification in robot-assisted surgeries. 3DCNNs provide a robust, real-time solution to higher precision robotic surgeries by lowering the overall error rate in Bayesian optimization while also allowing doctors complete situational awareness for important surgical choices.

articleTitle: StockAI - Stock Analysis Tool Agent
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: StockAI is a stock market analysis tool that integrates machine learning, traditional trading indicators, and intelligent agents to analyze live data and projections for stock investors. It does this by carrying out an analysis of the historical price trend of a stock and the ongoing stock markets from the use of mathematical indicators such as moving averages, relative strength index, and candlestick patterns. As a result, it aids in decision-making for both new and old traders. The system also leverages machine learning algorithms like random forests to generate price predictions with improved accuracy. StockAI’s interactive interface allows users to engage with the tool through natural language queries. However, challenges remain in evaluating the outputs of large language models, as current methods rely heavily on human evaluation.
