The ultimate goal of StockAI is to help investors make informed decisions, optimize market opportunities and mitigate risks through a combination of AI-driven analysis and traditional financial indicators.

articleTitle: Driver Safety Monitoring: Real-Time Detection Of Distraction And Drowsiness
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: A significant world main contributing factor to road accident is distracted driving. Drivers who are distracted are three times more possible to get in an accident than those who are not. For this reason, enhancing road safety requires the ability to identify driver distraction. Numerous earlier researches have put forth a variety of techniques for detecting driver distraction, including approaches based on images, sensors, and machine learning. However, the accuracy, complexity, and real-time performance of these approaches are limited This observe proposes a unique approach to motive force distraction detection with the aid of fusing the You Only Look Once (YOLO) goal identity system with a convolutional neural network (CNN). The categorization of the located objects and item detection the usage of YOLO are the 2 important levels of the proposed version. The driver’s face, hands, and other items that could distract them are among the many elements in their environment that the YOLO algorithm is used to recognize and find. Next, a CNN is used to categorize the things that have been spotted in order to ascertain whether or not the driver is distracted. The suggested model performs well in identifying driver distraction when tested on a public dataset. Additionally use the CNN algorithm to analyze the driver’s tiredness based on ocular attributes. The integration of the suggested technique into sophisticated driver assistance systems has promise for enhancing road safety in real-time conditions.

articleTitle: Adaptive Test Case Prioritization in Financial Applications Utilizing Graph Neural Networks and Crow Search Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: This paper proposes a Dynamic test case prioritization system using Reinforcement Learning, Graph Neural Network and Crow Search Algorithm The approach facilitates 98% coverage of codes, augmenting error detection, reducing execution time, and increasing scalability in financial cloud applications. The primary aim is to utilize Graph Neural Networks and financial cloud-based optimization strategies to develop a scalable test case prioritization system that is adaptive in nature and enhances fault detection, minimized execution time, and guarantees scalability. Graph Neural Networks for feature extraction and dynamic prioritization Crow Search Algorithm guarantees the effectiveness in terms of test case clustering, whereas Differential Evolution optimizes features. Reinforcement Learning determines prioritization dynamically based on real-time input and path-dependent program needs. The suggested approach outperformed traditional techniques like genetic algorithms and ant colony optimization, improving defect identification by 22%, cutting execution time by 24%, and achieving 98% code coverage. The framework greatly increases the efficiency and accuracy of test case prioritization of financial applications owing to its adaptive and error-detection capability besides an increased scalability towards large scale cloud systems.

articleTitle: Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation using Sign2gpt-Next Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: This work proposes a new approach to convert the data from sign language to spoken language without exposing the data to a gloss layer. Whenever gloss annotations are used which frequently are incomplete and act as an intermediate representation, it is usually found to be a bottleneck in translating sign language videos. In order to avoid this, the authors use a combination of modern machine learning algorithms to arrive at the conclusion. They use Dino-V2 Vision Transformer to implement the function of extracting the spatial features of the input sign language video frames. This model is particularly suitable for learning and visual patterns in general and particularly for capturing fine details of these patterns. Further, a spatio-temporal transformer layer is added to automate the temporal processing of the Sign-Language which helps in the arrangement of the body gestures and limb movements needed at a specific temporal frame. It is then translated into the desired spoken language using a multilingual Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) model. The approach can be said to be a big leap forward in sign language transliteration especially for such situations where few Gloss annotations are available, and making way for better and improved tools for the Deaf and the hard-of-hearing.

articleTitle: Harnessing Machine Learning and Image Processing for Prompt Disease Detection in Ocimum tenuiflorum Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: The agricultural landscape of India, a cornerstone of its economy, faces significant challenges in the early detection of leaf diseases, particularly in the cultivation of Ocimumtenuiflorum, widely revered for its medicinal properties. This study innovatively employs advanced image-processing techniques combined with machine learning algorithms to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of identifying infections in Holy Basil plants. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset sourced from Plant Village, which includes various infected leaf types and healthy specimens, we implemented a robust framework for image augmentation, preprocessing, and feature extraction. Our evaluation of multiple machine learning classifiers reveals that the random forest algorithm achieves the highest accuracy of $\mathbf{99.86\%}$, effectively outperforming other models such as linear discriminant analysis and support vector machines. By merging traditional agricultural knowledge with modern computational tools, this research not only demonstrates a novel approach to disease management in Ocimumtenuiflorum but also underscores the potential for technology to transform agricultural practices, promoting sustainability and enhancing crop productivity in India.

articleTitle: Microplastics Detection in Soil and Water: Leveraging IoT Technologies for Environmental Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: In recent times, the widespread presence of microplastics in soil and water presents serious environmental and health challenges, highlighting the need for effective monitoring and detection strategies. This paper explores the application of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to facilitate real-time and scalable identification of microplastics in various environmental contexts. It emphasizes the design and implementation of integrated IoT systems aimed at enhancing ecological monitoring and promoting sustainability. By utilizing advanced sensors, data analytics, and cloud computing platforms, IoT systems enable continuous and accurate tracking of microplastics distribution and concentration, providing vital information for pollution assessment and early warning. It also examines the deployment of affordable digital sensors, wireless communication methods, to improve the detection and monitoring of microplastics in both soil and water. These technologies using biosensors enable swift data transmission, remote access, data analysis of microplastics and classification based on its size, creates an effective framework for environmental management and pollution mitigation. This research highlights the significant potential of IoT based framework using biosensors in reducing the adverse effects of microplastics pollution on global ecosystems and promotes sustainable development.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Strategic Sales Forecasting in Retail Chains
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Sales of an individual item record maintained by supermarket chains/big retailers like Big Mart help in estimating consumer demand and thereby enable them to do effective inventory management. Through the analysis of data stored in the data warehouses, they access the anomalies and trends informing decision-making processes. This will be invaluable information to the retailers, in this case Big Mart, in predicting the future sales volume using machine learning techniques. A predictive model was developed utilizing XGBoost, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, and SVM techniques to forecast sales for businesses like Big Mart. It was found that this model outperforms existing ones, providing more accurate sales predictions and enabling better inventory management decisions.”

articleTitle: Computer vision for enhancing security and surveillance in a public space
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: One of the main issues in computer vision is object and action recognition. Object detection is to find anything in the scene, and action recognition tracks the subject’s movements. This paper proposes a method for improving real-time surveillance systems with OpenCV library and an upgraded YOLO v8 (You Only Look Once-version 8). The primary goal of the paper is surveillance and security. This study examines the training of computer systems to recognize digital patterns for supporting surveillance activities such as monitoring anomalous activity and criminal activity. It draws attention to the possibility of enhancing current object detection frameworks with cuttingedge artificial intelligence features to produce surveillance systems that are more perceptive and adaptable.

articleTitle: An IoMT-Enabled Healthcare System Employing Robotics and Deep Reinforcement Learning with Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs) for Dynamic Surgical Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: This research provides a Health IoMT with robotics, TCNs and DRL to analyze the dynamic surgical data in real-time. The technology means fewer human error, accurate decisions and better surgical precision. Objective: The goal of this study is to realize an automated optimization system for robotic-assisted surgery using DRL and TCNs with the IoMT. This real time monitoring of surgical performance will work as backbone for data analysis, better decision making in actual operative conditions and high-risk patients. Methods: Real-time data collecting during surgeries is made possible by the integration of IoMT devices in the proposed system. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) optimizes robotic movements, assuring precise tool placement and decisionmaking through continuous feedback, Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs) are used to analyze surgical data patterns. Result: Experimental analyses show that the proposed policy achieves (a) real-time performance in surgical data analysis and robotic assistance, which improves task accuracy to ${9 9. 2 0 \%}$ as well as precision of ${9 9. 2 0 \%}$, leading to a reduction by ${3 5 \%}$ error over current protocols. Conclusion: The method provides high benefits in dangerous/critical interventions and reduces human error by increasing accuracy, safety as well as real-time decision making to a robotic surgery.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of IoT Security, Trust Models, and Cloud-Based Solutions for Ensuring a Secure Connected Future
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) meteoric development is partly due to its ease of use. Up to 125 billion IoT connections are expected by 2030. Applications that enable IoT device connectivity make data protection a priority. Data privacy becomes more important as the need to prevent unlawful access develops. IoT connectivity benefits depend on networked device trust. Although growing, current security solutions cannot fully secure such a complex environment. Trust between devices reduces interconnection risks. This paper covers IoT security and trust model literature and discusses cloud IoT security challenges and solutions.

articleTitle: The Adverse Medication Interaction and Disease Correlation Analysis Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Medication interaction refers to the alteration of the action of one medicinal agent by virtue of the co-administration of another substance, which may include another drug, food products, or a specific pathological condition. Such interactions have the potential to cause severe pharmacological effects, highlighting the need for a quick, computational approach to predict medication interactions, as conventional methods are often time-consuming. To address this, a Large Language Model (LLM), trained on a vast corpus of data, was chosen as the base model and fine-tuned with a benchmark medication dataset to predict interactions between medications. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, including QLoRA, were applied to optimize performance while conserving computational resources. The resulting framework captures drug characteristics and interaction dynamics, ultimately predicting both the occurrence of a reaction and the expected outcome. For example, the combination of Diclofenac and Lepirudin significantly increases the risk of bleeding and hemorrhage. To a great extent, the computational models developed to predict interactions of drugs act as a good tool, which provide useful information for combination therapies and helping clinicians make more well-informed decisions, ultimately improving treatment outcomes and lowering the risk of adverse effects.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Identification of Birds in Agricultural Fields
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Studies on bird species provide important informa- tion about the biological systems that support the transportation of all life on Earth, including humans. Understanding bird species, their characteristics, migration patterns, and life cycles is important for maintaining ecological balance and a healthy planet. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and imaging tools have greatly improved the identification of bird species, helping in ecological research and agricultural management. However, identifying bird species in the field by photographing them remains a difficult and time-consuming task due to the similarity of class and quality attributes. Our research aims to address this challenge using deep learning, a machine learning technique that uses deep neural networks to identify birds accurately. We strive to develop and evaluate various CNN models such as VGG-19, Inception V3, DenseNet-201, EfficientNet-V2, and MobileNet-V3 to analyze the majority using advanced com- puter vision tools such as transfer learning and deep quantum learning. The model is effective. The model will form the basis for the construction of the most advanced (SOTA) classification of birds, achieving 88 percent accuracy with the DenseNet-201 model. In addition, innovations such as Bird@Edge, an instant bird identification and AI-based deterrent system designed to protect plants from harmful birds, demonstrate our mastery of applications in eight of our work in biodiversity monitoring and plant protection. Future developments will focus on improving the accuracy and functionality of the model, making it more useful for ecological protection and permaculture promotion, plant protection, biodiversity management.

articleTitle: Crop Recommendation Using Supervised Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)

authors.preferredName: Gandham Kumar N S L Prakash

abstract: Crop recommendation systems play a crucial role in optimizing agricultural productivity and resource utilization. In this research, we explore the application of machine learning models for enhancing crop recommendation accuracy in agriculture. In particular, we look into how well three well-known machine learning algorithms—Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Random Forest—perform in suggesting appropriate crops based on environmental and soil characteristics. Utilizing a dataset containing essential agricultural parameters such as nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium levels, temperature, humidity, pH, and rainfall, we conduct a comparative analysis of the models’ predictive capabilities. Through rigorous experimentation and evaluation, we assess the accuracy and effectiveness of each model in predicting crop labels. Our results shed light on the pros and cons of various machine learning techniques, which advances crop recommendation systems. This research offers valuable implications for precision agriculture and informs decisionmaking processes for sustainable crop management practices.

publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Computing and Intelligent Reality Technologies (ICCIRT)
abstract: Help desks at railway stations are meant to assist the local passengers so they can have their queries solved and without much hassle. This is particularly beneficial for the elderly who are limited by barriers of language and knowledge . We need to automate an already existing manual system of railway administration.The Robotic Assistant that we introduce is capable of catering to the needs of the people by making them feel that the assistant truly understands the heritage culture and language of the user using them in their own mother tongue especially in a country like India filled with diverse cultures.The robotic assistant processes the voice input from the user and performs all the necessary speech enhancement steps to ensure maximum clarity of speech .This polished speech output is converted to text .The text is fed into the model which returns the appropriate response in the native language chosen by the user. Thus assisting the user to respond appropriately for all Railway related Queries may it be navigation ,schedule info, contact details etc. The multilingual capability is the unique functionality of this system. The Queries posed to the system can be in the native language of the customer and they can expect a response in the same language.This Robot must cater to the needs of the local travelers arriving at a railway station regarding easy completion of administrative tasks. The Tasks include answering customer queries regarding ticket price or schedule of the trains on any day, a means to Contact different officials of the railway for further explanations .The multilingual capability is the unique functionality of this system. The Queries posed to the system can be in the native language of the customer and they can expect a response in the same language.
